title: Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san: Nekoyama-san to Onsen Ryokou
justification: AniList 20846 (SPECIAL, 1 episode(s) from 2014-07-18) is AniDB 10398's special(s) S1, aired 2014-07-18. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 20604, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 10398, and the special's title matches an AniList title. On TMDB 61530 the parent's node places the special(s) where TMDB's dates disagree (AniDB S1 aired 2014-07-18, TMDB 61530 S0E1 2014-07-14), so the bridged record publishes no TMDB value.
